Investor.name: Investor
Investor.definition: Party, either an individual or organisation, whose assets are being invested.

QualifiedForeignIntermediary.name: Qualified Foreign Intermediary
QualifiedForeignIntermediary.definition: Foreign financial institution which has been authorised by local authorities to act as account management institution in the country.

StockExchange.name: Stock Exchange
StockExchange.definition: Identification of the stock exchange to which transaction reporting will be done.

TradeRegulator.name: Trade Regulator
TradeRegulator.definition: Institution to which a trade must be reported.

TripartyAgent.name: Triparty Agent
TripartyAgent.definition: Party responsible for the administration of a tri-party collateral transaction including collateral allocation, marking to market and substitution of collateral.

InvestorCountryCodeRule.definition: If Investor is used with a country code, then the country code specifies the nationality of the investor, for example, for the settlement of certain securities (that is, airlines, defence manufacturers) under the EU legislation.
